-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.idxLockG_at (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (n : Nat) : mvcc.idxLockG γ n ⊣⊢ mvcc.idxLockGAt γ n
    (-1)

theorem mvcc.idx_publish (ti : Loc) (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (log : mvcc.Log)
    (hrep : mvcc.IdxCRep (-1) (mvcc.evsOf (log ++ [[]])) (mvcc.idxOfEntries L)) : ⊢ mvcc.ownIdxPriv
    ti L -∗ mvcc.idxLockG γ (mvcc.evsOf (log ++ [[]])).length -∗ mvcc.idxWriterLb γ log ={⊤}=∗
    mvcc.isTreeIndex ti γ ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (),
    mvcc.idxReader ti γ

theorem mvcc.idx_renew (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (n : Nat) : ⊢ |==> ∃ nv cm, monoNatAuthOwn nv 1 n ∗
    monoNatLbOwn nv n ∗ ghostVar cm 1 (-1, [])

def mvcc.idxLockG (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoNatAuthOwn γ.nev 1 n ∗ mvcc.crevLb γ (-1) ∗ (∃ log₀, monoListLbOwn γ.log log₀) ∗ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ 1 [] (-1))

theorem mvcc.idxReaders_of_toks (ti t : Loc) (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (n : Nat) : (typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex go!"tree" ti) t DFrac.discard ∗
    [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.idxMuAddr ti) (mvcc.idxLockInv t γ)) ⊢
    [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), mvcc.idxReader ti γ

theorem mvcc.idxCmpOwn_nil (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (q : Qp) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (c : Int) :
    mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q [] c ⊢ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ q L c

theorem mvcc.btInsert_perm_of_new {V : Type} {less : V → V → Prop} [DecidableRel less] (v : V) (L :
    List V) : (∀ (w : V), w ∈ L → less w v ∨ less v w) → (btInsert less v L).Perm (v :: L)

def mvcc.ownIdxPriv (ti : Loc) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ t lg,
      typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex go!"tree" ti) t
          DFrac.discard ∗
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.treeIndex go!"lg" ti) lg
            DFrac.discard ∗
          zapLoggerOk lg ∗ typedPointsto (mvcc.idxMuAddr ti) rwZero (DFrac.own 1) ∗ mvcc.ownTree t L 1)

theorem mvcc.idxFresh_split (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) : mvcc.idxFresh γ ⊢ |==> (monoNatAuthOwn γ.nev 1 0 ∗
    ghostVar γ.cmp 1 (-1, []) ∗ mvcc.crevLb γ (-1) ∗ monoListLbOwn γ.log [] ∗ mvcc.idxWriter γ [] []
    ∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ (Qp.half 1) [] ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ 1 (-1))

def mvcc.idxLockGAt (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (n : Nat) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoNatAuthOwn γ.nev 1 n ∗
      mvcc.crevLb γ c ∗ (∃ log₀, monoListLbOwn γ.log log₀ ∗ ⌜c < ↑(List.length log₀)⌝) ∗ mvcc.idxCmpOwn γ 1 [] c)

theorem mvcc.idx_publishAt (ti : Loc) (γ : mvcc.IdxNames) (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (log : mvcc.Log)
    (c : Int) (hrep : mvcc.IdxCRepN c (mvcc.evsOf (log ++ [[]])) (mvcc.idxOfEntries L)) (hc : -1 ≤
    c) : ⊢ mvcc.ownIdxPriv ti L -∗ mvcc.idxLockGAt γ (mvcc.evsOf (log ++ [[]])).length c -∗
    mvcc.idxWriterLb γ log ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.isTreeIndex ti γ ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate
    sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), mvcc.idxReader ti γ
